subject.title: Feature: Webchat / Control UI inline button support (buttons parameter, callback RPC, capabilities config)

question: Should WebChat/Control UI inline interactions use shared presentation typed actions with a new authenticated chat.callback RPC, and should any WebChat capability/config key exist despite WebChat currently having no persisted config section?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent public protocol, callback security model, and config surface require maintainer intent before implementation.

options.title: Approve presentation plus RPC
options.body: Use shared presentation blocks for final chat events/history and add an authenticated chat.callback method with explicit session, message, block, and action binding; keep webhook routing out of v1.

options.title: Split protocol before UI
options.body: Land a maintainer-reviewed Gateway protocol and callback authorization design first, then implement Control UI rendering in a follow-up.

options.title: Avoid WebChat config
options.body: Expose inline controls through client negotiation or always-on authenticated UI behavior instead of reviving retired WebChat config keys.

recommendation.title: Approve presentation plus RPC
recommendation.body: Use shared presentation blocks for final chat events/history and add an authenticated chat.callback method with explicit session, message, block, and action binding; keep webhook routing out of v1.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current history signal across the Gateway protocol, WebChat docs, and Control UI chat-rendering surfaces.
